card.name: The word substrate in enzyme interactions
card.fires_on: The word substrate, or its first pieces (substr, Sub-str), when a drug is described as a substrate of a CYP enzyme or transporter.

modes.label: Split-up substrate
modes.description: The first piece of substrate is split across tokens, as in substr or Sub-str, before the ending.
modes.example: D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4) that mediate drug and xenobiotic metabolism using isoform selective marker<< substr>>ates and human liver microsomal preparations

modes.label: Whole word substrate
modes.description: The full word substrate follows 'a' or a drug and an enzyme name.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to this pattern, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word substrate when a label says a drug is broken down by a liver enzyme such as CYP3A4.
